description: Timing-dependent test: the side-menu client navigation to /store is awaited with a 600 ms toHaveURL timeout, which the next dev storefront sometimes misses. The first attempt failed (still on /dk after 600 ms), the retry passed; nothing deterministic is broken. A test-side timing fix (automation_defect) is also accepted.
source: Local run against the Docker AUT with CLIENT_NAV temporarily lowered from 45 s to 600 ms in tests/storefront/navigation.spec.ts (reverted afterwards), only this test, --retries=1; repeated until Playwright recorded it as flaky (run 6 of 6: 4 failed both attempts, 1 passed). No changes.diff.

tests.title: side menu navigates to the store listing
